description: CR 612.1 a hack to a type nobody controls BINDS a Crasher the board had freed
note: Glacial Crasher "can't attack unless there is a Mountain on the battlefield" names a basic land type in its CR 508.1c gate, and the gate reads the whole battlefield, so the swap is the only thing under test. alice holds a Magical Hack and the Island that pays for it; bob has no creature. bob's Mountain lifts the printed gate; Mountain -> Forest rewrites it to a type nobody controls, so the Crasher is not offered: no declare-attackers prompt comes, and an unscheduled one would fail the run.
